meta.title: During submission time, bids are on Sum Total and auto-broken down pro rata
gaps: Verify that each item value is mathematically broken down pro rata from the vendor's Sum Total.
Verify that the vendor's total amount is visually highlighted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that each item value is mathematically broken down pro rata from the vendor's Sum Total.; Verify that the vendor's total amount is visually highlighted.

steps.note: Open an existing live auction with vendor bids so the response behavior can be inspected.
Navigate to the buyer's Responses view during the bidding window.
Assert that responses are presented with a Sum Total bid basis.
Assert that submissions are identified as automatically broken down bids.
Confirm the response screen has no rendering errors or raw invalid values.
